description: This file is a shell script used for testing git remerge-diff functionality, including setup of test environments, execution of specific git commands, and validation of remerge-diff outputs. It contains multiple test cases designed to verify the behavior and correctness of remerge-diff across various scenarios such as clean merges, conflicts, pathspec filtering, submodule handling, conflict types, and options like --reverse.

methods.name: test_write_lines
methods.description: Writes specified lines into a file, used for preparing test files with predefined content.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success; runs commands and checks assertions.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Asserts that the command should fail, used for testing failure scenarios.

methods.name: test_must_be_empty
methods.description: Checks that the provided output is empty, used for verifying expected absence of output.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares two files or output streams to verify they are identical.
